audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart had Cassiopeia on all 7 rows while the content layer and the packet chart both say Naafiri on all 7 — the two layers rendered opposite answers.
audit.why: Cassiopeia is immobile with only Flash; the packet levelChart, the content win[] and whys[], and the 51% win rate all agree Naafiri holds every stage while respecting Miasma and R facing. Flipped the full sides to agree, ratings moderated to 5-6/10 since Miasma makes it a piloting test, not a stomp.

audit.why: Spikes accurate: 3-5 all-in between her poke cooldowns, 6 flank around R facing, first-item burst before Twin Fang ramp, late she scales but stays immobile. All four present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits; tradeGood/trading/dos/donts misgendered Cassiopeia and pasted tradeGood/tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Miasma (W, 24s at rank 1) grounds — Naafiri's Q dash, E and R are movement abilities it denies; W untargetability is not a dash and still works. Her Q is 3.5s (near-permanent poke), E is 0.75s sustain that anti-heal must answer, R is 120s and only stuns if you face her. Naafiri Q at 900 range outranges Twin Fang's 700.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the grounding interaction written into cooldowns/trading; genders fixed everywhere lint flagged.
